name: MySync Connector for MYOB
author: mysync

sections.description:
This plugin adds WooCommerce > MySync Connector for MYOB with useful tools inside WordPress:

  • Check the HTTPS store address, WooCommerce version, permalink configuration and registered WooCommerce REST product route.
  • Review products and individual variations, 25 per page, using local WooCommerce data.
  • Find missing or duplicate SKUs and stock-management settings to review before connecting MYOB.
  • Open the product editor to correct a SKU or stock setting.
  • Download a JSON environment report for troubleshooting, without API secrets, orders or customer records.
  • Open the hosted MySync app when ready to connect your accounts and choose transfer rules.

These local checks are free and work without a MySync account or an external service connection. They do not edit products or establish whether a MYOB item exists. Local readiness does not prove that an external server can reach your store.

The optional hosted service is available at https://app.mysync.io/accountright-woocommerce. It provides the accounting integration, imports, inventory transfers, scheduling and sync history described below.

Free includes manual inventory updates and read-only imports. Basic AUD14/month
adds scheduling, including every 15 minutes. Plus AUD28/month adds customers,
sales orders, invoices and supported confirmed payments. Pro AUD44/month adds
product creation and price updates. Prices are per connected store, billed through
Stripe. Paid plans include a 14-day trial.

Refunds are imported for review. Automatic MYOB credits/refunds and third-party
warehouse plugin allocation are not included in this release.

The plugin reads local product and variation information for diagnostics. It does not run the sync engine, modify checkout or access order tables.
It declares HPOS compatibility because it does not use the order database.

Developer and platform names

MySync develops and supports this plugin under its own brand. MYOB and WooCommerce identify the third-party platforms it connects and are trademarks of their respective owners. This independent connector is not affiliated with, endorsed by or developed by MYOB or WooCommerce.

External services and privacy

Viewing the plugin page, reviewing products and downloading diagnostics do not contact MySync or send store data externally. The downloaded report contains plugin, WordPress, WooCommerce and PHP versions, the public store URL, currency and local readiness results. It is generated on request and is not stored by the plugin or sent to support automatically.

Clicking Open MySync opens https://app.mysync.io in a new tab and includes only your public store URL. This plugin sends no passwords, keys or customer records and adds no analytics.

If you connect, WooCommerce generates read/write REST API keys and sends them
directly to MySync. The hosted backend encrypts keys and MYOB tokens. Imported
products, customers, orders, payments and refunds are stored in your hosted account.
Enabled flows may update stock, products and prices or create MYOB customers,
sales documents and payments. Review your settings before transferring.

Manage or cancel paid billing in Account & help > Manage billing. Deactivating or
deleting this connector does not cancel the hosted subscription. Disconnect in
MySync to remove stored credentials. Revoke the source REST key in WooCommerce
and MYOB connected application to remove provider permissions. Contact support
for hosted account/data deletion.

Privacy: https://mysync.io/privacy.html
Terms: https://mysync.io/terms.html
Support: https://help.mysync.io/guides/myob-sync-woocommerce-guide
sections.installation:
1. Activate WooCommerce on a public HTTPS store with working REST API permalinks.
  2. Upload this ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin and activate it.
  3. Open WooCommerce > MySync Connector for MYOB. Review Store readiness and Product matching and stock review; correct relevant issues using the product editor. Download diagnostics if needed.
  4. Select Open MySync to open the hosted service. Sign in or create your MySync account.
  5. Select WooCommerce if prompted. Open Connections and approve WooCommerce access, then connect MYOB and select your company file. The hosted app prepares your store setup.
  6. Import a small sample, review matches/settings, then run the selected flows.
sections.faq:
Is an account required?

No account is required for local diagnostics and product reviews. To use hosted syncing, sign in or register with MySync, then approve WooCommerce access and connect your MYOB company file. The hosted service has Free and paid plans.

Does activation send information to MySync?

No. Local diagnostics do not contact MySync. Clicking Open MySync includes your public store URL. The hosted service accesses store records only after you approve its connection.

Is this plugin required?

No. MySync can connect directly through WooCommerce’s approval page.

Does deleting the plugin cancel billing or revoke API keys?

No. Cancel in MySync billing settings and revoke provider access separately.

Do local checks change my stock or products?

No. They are read-only. Product editor links let you make corrections using WooCommerce. Actual transfers are configured and run in the hosted service.
